北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴天湿度高，体感略闷。注意通风，穿衣舒适哦。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is overcast and humid, feeling a bit stuffy. Ventilate and dress comfortably.

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波多云体感热，湿度高。外出防晒，多补水，穿衣清爽。
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo is cloudy and feels hot, high humidity. Sunscreen outdoors, hydrate, and dress lightly.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天体感热。湿度大，出门带伞，注意防晒补水。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast and feels hot. High humidity, bring an umbrella, protect from sun and hydrate.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云湿度大，体感闷热。记得多补水，穿透气衣物。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and very humid, feeling muggy. Remember to hydrate and wear breathable clothes.
广州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴天酷热，体感高达 37℃。务必防晒，多喝水防中暑。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and extremely hot, feeling up to 37℃. Be sure to protect from sun, hydrate to prevent heatstroke.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州多云风力 4 级，体感舒适。外出注意防晒，小心着凉。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy with Force 4 wind, feeling comfortable. Protect from sun and avoid catching a chill.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴朗微风，体感舒适。是出游的好天气，别忘防晒。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny with a gentle breeze, feeling comfortable. Great weather for outings, don't forget sun protection.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天体感热。北风微凉，仍需注意补水防晒。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast and feels hot. The north wind is slightly cool, but still hydrate and protect from sun.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云，体感微热。湿度适中，保持好心情哦！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, feeling slightly warm. Humidity is moderate, stay in a good mood!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天体感热，记得多喝水。出门注意防晒补水哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast and feels hot, remember to hydrate. When going out, protect from sun and drink water.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云酷热，气温 35℃。注意防暑降温，及时补水。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and extremely hot, temperature 35℃. Prevent heatstroke, cool down, and hydrate promptly.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云风力 4 级，体感舒适。早晚温差大，注意添衣。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy with Force 4 wind, feeling comfortable. Large temperature difference morning/evening, add clothes.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云体感热，湿度适中。注意防晒，及时补充水分。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy and feels hot, moderate humidity. Protect from sun and replenish water promptly.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云体感舒适，气候宜人。享受好天气，心情愉悦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and feels comfortable, pleasant climate. Enjoy the good weather and stay cheerful.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云体感热，湿度大。外出防晒，多喝水，小心中暑。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy and feels hot, high humidity. Sunscreen outdoors, drink plenty of water, watch out for heatstroke.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云体感舒适，微风阵阵。享受海风，别忘防晒哦。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and feels comfortable, with gentle breezes. Enjoy the sea breeze, but don't forget sun protection.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云体感微热，湿度高。外出注意防晒，及时补水。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feeling slightly warm, high humidity. Sunscreen outdoors, replenish water promptly.

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦多云酷热，体感 37℃。务必防暑，多喝水，避开高温时段。
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu is cloudy and extremely hot, feeling 37℃. Be sure to prevent heatstroke, hydrate, avoid high-temperature hours.

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪艳阳高照，体感炎热。多喝水，防晒，小心中暑哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny and hot. Drink plenty of water, use sunscreen, and beware of heatstroke!
